assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 229% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 229 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and the country has lost its measles elimination status.

Polio cases are peaking in Syria with three confirmed cases of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 reported in Deir Ez Zor Governorate, and Wikipedia readership is at the 96th percentile of the past year.

Dengue cases in the US are peaking with an 853% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 83 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and Wikipedia readership is at the 55th percentile of the past year.

Mpox cases in the US are peaking with an 87% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 52 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and Wikipedia readership is at the 55th percentile of the past year.
Influenza activity is at baseline with a 25% increase in global flu test positivity over the past month, and WHO reported three cases of influenza A(H5N1) in Washington State, USA.

West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 1388% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 115 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and Wikipedia readership is at the 0th percentile of the past year.

Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 45% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 249 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and Wikipedia readership is at the 11th percentile of the past year.

Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline with a 30% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 7 cases per week in the week of 2026-10-31, and Switzerland reported four locally acquired cases.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising, with a 55% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months and 12,586 cases this year compared to 30,326 in the same period last year.
Malaria cases in the US are at baseline with a 30% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, but fewer cases this year (1,161) than last year (1,448).
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) Wikipedia readership is rising, at the 37th percentile of the past year.
Hepatitis A cases in the US are at baseline with a 10% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, but fewer cases this year (630) than last year (941).
Norovirus Wikipedia readership is at baseline, at the 40th percentile of the past year.
Meningococcal meningitis cases in the US are at baseline with a 26% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, but fewer cases this year (273) than last year (397).
Global respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) test positivity is rising, with 1.8% positivity this week up 17% from the previous month, and Wikipedia readership at the 57th percentile of the past year.
